verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw is a law firm offering legal advisory services, so 'operating the product with natural-language commands' is a category error: there is no software product to command. The evidence covers only practice areas, publications, and offices, and nothing shows the firm ships any natural-language or agentic interface that would make the axis apply.
